comment: The judge of the forged stzv court, written BEFORE the court: the families the forms document spells, member for member as the rule generates them (each subset of the offered parameter forms in the order offered, as the plain name, then the fluent name, then the passive name), and the verdict principle 7 gives each of the document's names -- RemoveFFQ is the FF clash (point 7), UppercasingFQ a fluent form with no plain twin (point 2), FindFirstXT a member outside its family's offered forms (point 6), FindQCS the fluent form not last, ToJSON a trailing run no suffix spells; FindLasteAsSection, WithoutSapces and NearstTo AGREE, because this court judges the forms grammar and not the dictionary -- the misspelled form is the computing altitude's refusal (an unknown name), named in v12/GRAMMAR.md.

spellings.name: FindNextSTCS
spellings.contains: base=FindNext forms=[st, cs] member of find_next

spellings.name: ReplaceQ
spellings.contains: base=Replace forms=[] fluent member of replace

spellings.name: FindFirstSTDZZ
spellings.contains: forms=[st, d, zz] member of find_first

spellings.name: FindFirstXT
spellings.contains: the family find_first offers [st, d, zz, cs] and not the forms of FindFirstXT

spellings.name: FindQCS
spellings.contains: the fluent form Q is not last

spellings.name: ToJSON
spellings.contains: ends in 'JSON', which no declared suffix spells
